title: Update planned task-sync reconciliation to use claims and ordinary receipts
outcome: Update planned task-sync reconciliation to use claims and ordinary receipts
acceptance: The planned reconciliation text in docs/spec.md and docs/features/git-task-sync.md uses ordinary claims, work-session associations and exact-key receipt retry, and no longer depends on removed turn admission, grants, checkpoints or begin/evaluate requests; it preserves uncertain request identity and independent host-action authority
